assumptions.statement: The repository SITE_BOUNDARY and three KEY_AREA polygons are provisional rough geometry, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All siting, area and route conclusions are concept-only; official polygons trigger full recalculation of geometry, metrics, figures, PDFs and HTML.

assumptions.statement: Approved FAR, height, density, setback, road, parking and facility controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No statutory development intensity or engineering quantity is claimed.

assumptions.statement: Verified night footfall, shift times, light, glare, noise, heat, ecology and service-hour baselines are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Environmental values and service outcomes remain unknown; measure before setting numeric thresholds.

assumptions.statement: Existing buildings, ownership, structure, fire, utilities, heritage and underground conditions are unverified.
assumptions.impact: Concept footprints test capacity only; retain, renovate or demolish decisions require professional surveys.

assumptions.statement: Live road, rail, station, final-service and safety-interface data are not supplied as trusted design inputs.
assumptions.impact: Concept routes are not navigation, approved road alignments or rail-control proposals.

assumptions.statement: All AI and robotics pilots are design proposals only and have not been authorised or operated.
assumptions.impact: Scenario counts are coverage; no field safety, accuracy, complaint or efficiency result is claimed.

assumptions.statement: Named owners are proposed role combinations; no institution, budget, procurement or insurance commitment is confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Projects require governance, permission, insurance, labour, safety, data and exit arrangements before implementation.
